items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: And Nick's a fellow from here. Not from here. He's from Raceland, but he's an older man to me named Bo Bo. Used to be a tuba player way back there with Buddy Bowling. And he picked me up in Brompton, New Orleans, one time. And I come in and played a while

ctx.x: Raceland, Louisiana, yeah. And so, a fellow by the name of Paul Rozier, like eight miles from my home, he picked up on me and brought me in his band. He had a band there, and I used to play with him all the time. Another fellow named Mike Taylor, one mile from there. And Nick's a fellow from here. Not from here. He's from Raceland, but he's an older man to me named Bo Bo. Used to be a tuba player way back there with Buddy Bowling. And he picked me up in Brompton, New Orleans, one time. And I come in and played a…
Who else was in the band when you went up? Who else played in that band with you?
